title: Step 1
criteria: Accept a model with a single downward-pointing triangular silhouette, a long horizontal top edge, and two diagonal edges meeting at the lower point. Reject a square or diamond sheet, an upright triangle, or any model with extra visible flaps that break the simple triangle silhouette.

title: Step 2
criteria: Accept a model with an upright kite or diamond silhouette, left and right side points, top and bottom points, and two narrow front flaps meeting along the vertical center near the bottom. Reject a downward triangle or a plain kite or diamond without the narrow center flaps.

title: Step 3
criteria: Accept a diamond-shaped model with a clear horizontal crease across the middle and two narrow upright flaps rising from the middle to the top center. Reject a closed kite or diamond that lacks the horizontal middle crease or the narrow top-center flaps.

title: Step 4
criteria: Accept a model with a large lower diamond, a horizontal crease across the middle, triangular side flaps opened upward to the left and right, and a narrow upright flap at the top center. Reject a plain diamond or a model without the opened left and right triangular side flaps.

title: Step 5
criteria: Accept a model with upper side flaps behind a large centered upward-pointing front triangle, with the triangle base along the middle crease and its point near the upper center. Reject a model without the large centered upward front triangle or with a front triangle pointing downward below the middle crease.

title: Step 6
criteria: Accept a model with upper side flaps, a small centered triangle between them, a wide horizontal band across the middle, and a large downward diamond below the band. Reject a model where a large upward-pointing triangle covers the center or the wide middle band is missing.

title: Step 7
criteria: Accept a model with upper side flaps, a small centered triangle above the middle, and a long shallow horizontal base across the bottom. Reject a model with a large downward diamond below the middle or without the long shallow bottom base.
